description: This file contains unit tests for the 'resulttool' module, specifically testing result aggregation, regression comparison, and result merging functionalities within the 'oeqa.selftest' framework.

classes.name: ResultToolTests
classes.description: A test case class for testing result tool functionalities within the oeqa selftest framework.

methods.name: test_report_can_aggregate_test_result
methods.description: Tests the aggregation of test results into counts of passed, failed, and skipped.

methods.name: test_regression_can_get_regression_base_target_pair
methods.description: Tests the pairing of base and target results based on configuration.

methods.name: test_regrresion_can_get_regression_result

methods.name: test_merge_can_merged_results
methods.description: Tests merging and flattening of multiple result datasets.
